name: Pablo Picasso
bio: Spanish painter, sculptor, printmaker, ceramicist, and stage designer who spent most of his adult life in France. Co-founded the Cubist movement and invented constructed sculpture.
bioPl: Hiszpański malarz, rzeźbiarz i grafik. Współtwórca kubizmu, rewolucjonista sztuki XX wieku i jedna z najbardziej wpływowych postaci nowoczesnej kultury.

catalog.title: Guernica
catalog.description: Monumental anti-war masterpiece depicting the tragic bombing of Guernica during the Spanish Civil War.

catalog.title: Les Demoiselles d'Avignon
catalog.location: Museum of Modern Art (MoMA), New York
catalog.locationPl: Museum of Modern Art (MoMA), Nowy Jork
catalog.description: Revolutionary proto-Cubist masterpiece deconstructing female figures into geometric planes.

catalog.title: The Old Guitarist
catalog.description: Famous Blue Period painting depicting a blind, haggard musician hunched over his guitar.
